summary: Package loads and executes remote JavaScript from a mutable Bitbucket URL
details: The package ships a single index.html (declared as main) that, when opened, fetches content from https://bitbucket.org/p2p-alt-public/p2p-emis/raw/main/GameWebSight and injects it into a newly opened browser window via document.write, executing whatever script the remote returns. The reference is a mutable `main` branch with no commit pin or integrity check, and the hosting account is not tied to any verified publisher of this package. There are no install/preinstall/postinstall lifecycle scripts, so `npm install` does not trigger the fetch — the remote code runs only when a user opens index.html in a browser. Package metadata is also placeholder-grade (empty author, no repository, generic description). The behavior is unsafe (mutable third-party content embedded in a runtime page, no SRI, owner of the Bitbucket repo can swap the payload at any time), but it does not auto-execute on install/import and there is no observed exfiltration, credential access, or installer-side destruction.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
